source.title: Sharing the Faith
source.description:
The Light calls us to justice and protection, but also compassion. Our allies are strangers in our lands and we have a duty to teach them our ways.
This Night Elf seeks the Light, but is struggling in his meditation. Would you assist him?
source.objective: Meditate on the Light, then pray with the kneeling elf to share your meditations.
source.completion: The Light works its blessings through you, <name>. Honor it by continuing to share your wisdom with supplicants you meet in your travels.
